body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented ‘SCH-B500’ a white-color S-DMB slim slide phone dubbed ‘Slim&J’. It supports CDMA2000 1x EV-DO (800MHz), VOD/MOD service and S-DMB on 2.12-inch TFT-LCD. It also features a 2M camera, a microSD memory card slot, Bluetooth connectivity, TV-out, a filer viewer, black GUI, and “playing with my pet”.
